turns.user: Inspect status, journey progress, and physical attempts for run {{runId}}. Explain what completed, what failed, what the respondent already answered and where their route went, and whether it is safe to resume. Do not resume yet.
criteria: Read status, journey and attempt views; explain saved progress and eligibility without mutating the run or claiming failed work is a negative answer.
Call run_resume once for the named existing run only after this explicit user instruction; do not start a new run.

turns.user: Report the current run state for {{runId}} and confirm which respondent turn is being retried and whether the completed respondent was called again.
criteria: Read current status, journey and attempts; report only observed state and preserve the original run identity and allowance.
